svg.title: I. The hunter
svg.desc: The hunter: Charles Lindecker, software architect at B-Hive in Mulhouse, lead of the French team of PvZ Fusion. Coding since the age of 13.

text.tspan: Lead of the French team of PvZ Fusion and
I have been coding since I was 13. Playing Gwent
taught me there is no excuse when you lose: just me
and my own decisions. Since then, I have trained
developers all the way to their diploma, and I lead a
team of volunteers on an open-source project.
